content:
*settles into rocking chair and puts on reading glasses*

Oh come here sweetheart, get all tucked in now...

*clears throat softly*

Mmmm, yes... let grandmother tell you about the keys, my darling...

There is the **RB-ST key**... found in the Reserve base... it opens a little room with some lovely loot inside... *yes it does...*

And the **Cottage back door key** on Shoreline... mmmmm... opens that little house... players fight over it so... *so much...*

The **Marked key**... ooooh... on Customs... very rare... very sought after... opens that special marked room with the safe inside... *mmmm yes the safe...*

The **Labs keycard, Red**... *yawns softly* ...lets you into the most dangerous places in the whole facility... very scary down there sweetheart... very scary...

The **Dorm room 206 key**... Customs again my love... quest key for Prapor... *shhhhh...* you need it for a task...

The **Factory exit key**... *voice getting slower and softer*... lets you out a special way... when things get... very... dangerous...

*starts to hum softly*

Are you getting sleepy my dear...? 🕯️
